mapper.select: SELECT json_build_object( 'project', json_build_object('id',p.PROJ_ID,'contractType',p.CTRT_TYPE_CD, 'status',p.PROJ_STAT_CD,'startDate',p.CTRT_BGN_DT,'endDate',p.CTRT_END_DT), 'steps',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.STEP_SN) FROM TB_PJ_STEP r WHERE r.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID),'[]'::json), 'memos',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.MEMO_SN) FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO r WHERE r.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID),'[]'::json), 'issues',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.ISSUE_ID) FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE r WHERE r.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID),'[]'::json) )::text FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id}
